summary: Trenches fitted out like positions dug since 2022 (patchy log and salvage shoring, loose bag heaps at firing points, debris, patchy duckboards, a log-framed dugout door with a tarpaulin) and squads sheltering in dugouts under shellfire.
rationale: Matched uncropped before/after stills show the fittings; a close-up sheet shows the dugout entrance, shoring and firing points; a short clip shows the shelter-and-stand-to behaviour, which a still cannot.

capture.clip_frames: 90-305 of 320, one frame per three 30 Hz ticks (10 per simulated second)
capture.clip_command_note: JPEG frames piped to ffmpeg: -f image2pipe -framerate 15 -c:v mjpeg -i pipe:0 -vf format=yuv420p -c:v libvpx-vp9 -crf 36 -b:v 0 -row-mt 1 -g 60 -an
capture.review: Inspected native Forward+ (line, dugout entrance, gun bay, inside the cut). Reworked after review for a modern, less regular look; camouflage nets tried and dropped (the netting reads as a plastic sheet up close). The mortar barrage in the clip is an observer demonstration (no side fired it).
